# DSH Studio v0.9.1

这是一个针对 0.9.0 的稳定性修复版本，集中解决 Windows 安装/升级后 Harness 偶发无法启动、
手动检查更新没有反馈、非 Git 工作区报致命错误，以及发布测试污染真实安装目录的问题。

## 新增

- **备用更新源随 Release 直接发布。** 正式资产和 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 完成后，发布流水线会重新生成
  已签名更新清单并直接部署 GitHub Pages，不再依赖 Release 事件再次触发另一条工作流。
- **安装包状态隔离。** CI 中的 NSIS 安装、覆盖升级与安装版烟雾测试使用独立的 Studio、Harness、
  Profile 和应用数据目录，避免测试数据进入真实用户环境。

## 变更与安全

- 本地发布演练默认使用 MSI 管理提取验证安装版可执行文件，不再注册临时 NSIS 安装；完整的 NSIS
  安装和 0.9.0 → 0.9.1 原位升级测试仍在一次性的 GitHub Actions Windows Runner 中执行。
- Harness 仅对“Profile 中的官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` 模块在托管运行时链接切换期间短暂不可用”这一
  安装器所有的竞态进行更长但有界的自动恢复。第三方插件缺失、配置错误及其他加载错误仍立即保留
  原因并停止，不会被无条件重试掩盖。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复安装或升级后偶发出现 `harness closed its output without announcing a port`，并伴随
  `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/…' imported from …\.dsh\profiles\web` 的启动失败。
- 修复启动时后台静默检查仍在进行时，点击“检查更新”会被直接忽略的问题；手动检查现在加入同一请求，
  并显示“已是最新版本”、可用版本或可复制的错误详情。
- 修复普通非 Git 目录打开 Worktree 管理器时显示
  `fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git`；现在显示空状态，并禁用
  需要 Git 仓库的创建操作。
- 修复本地打包验证可能把 Temp 下的测试副本注册成 Windows 主安装目录，导致开始菜单、卸载项或后续
  升级继续指向已删除路径的问题。
- Harness 自动恢复耗尽后改为简短、可操作的提示，不再把整段 Node/Cordis 调用栈作为主错误；
  Profile 与用户插件不会因此被删除。

## 安装与更新

0.9.1 支持从 0.9.0 原位升级，现有 `~/.dsh` Profile、插件、工作区、会话和凭据都会保留。
请使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核对下载；应用内更新继续强制验证 Tauri 更新签名。

本版本已在 Windows 11 上完成真实用户 Profile 的 Harness 冷启动、HTTP 就绪、安装版烟雾测试和
稳定安装目录验证。当前没有 Apple 真机；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 与 Universal 资产会经过编译、
单元测试、完整运行时 headless 启动和更新签名检查，但不宣称完成 Gatekeeper、VoiceOver 或安装器
真机人工验收。系统发布者签名状态以最终公开资产核验结果为准。

[英文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.1/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.1/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [比较 v0.9.0...v0.9.1](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1)

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.9.1

This stability release for 0.9.0 addresses intermittent Harness startup after a Windows install or upgrade, a silent
manual update check, fatal Git errors in ordinary non-repository workspaces, and package tests contaminating the real
Windows installation path.

## Added

- **Release-owned fallback publishing.** After formal assets and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are complete, the release workflow
  regenerates the signed updater manifest and deploys it directly to GitHub Pages without depending on a second
  workflow being triggered by the Release event.
- **Package-test state isolation.** CI NSIS install, in-place upgrade and packaged-app smoke tests receive isolated
  Studio, Harness, Profile and application-data directories.

## Changed and secured

- Local release rehearsals verify the packaged executable through MSI administrative extraction and no longer register
  a temporary NSIS installation. Full NSIS install and 0.9.0 → 0.9.1 upgrade testing remains enabled on ephemeral
  GitHub Actions Windows runners.
- A longer but bounded Harness retry applies only when an official `@deepseek-ai/*` module imported from a Profile is
  briefly unavailable while Studio promotes its managed runtime junction. Missing third-party plugins, invalid
  configuration and other loader failures still stop immediately with their original reason.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed intermittent `harness closed its output without announcing a port` failures after install or upgrade with
  `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/…' imported from …\.dsh\profiles\web` in the loader output.
- Fixed **Check for updates** being silently ignored while the quiet launch-time request was still running. A manual
  check now joins that request and surfaces the up-to-date state, available release or copyable failure details.
- Fixed the Worktree Manager showing
  `fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git` for an ordinary non-Git directory. It now
  presents an empty state and disables repository-only creation controls.
- Fixed local package verification registering a Temp smoke-test copy as the primary Windows installation, which could
  leave Start Menu, uninstall and later upgrade paths pointing at a deleted directory.
- When managed-module recovery is exhausted, Studio now shows a short actionable message instead of presenting the
  complete Node/Cordis stack as the primary error. Profiles and user plugins are not deleted.

## Install and update

Version 0.9.1 is an in-place upgrade from 0.9.0. Existing `~/.dsh` Profiles, plugins, workspaces, sessions and
credentials are preserved. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates continue to require a valid Tauri
updater signature.

This release was validated on Windows 11 with a real user Profile Harness cold boot, HTTP readiness, packaged binary
smoke test and stable install-path inspection. No Apple device is currently available. macOS Intel, Apple Silicon and
Universal assets are compiled, unit-tested, headless-booted with the full runtime and updater-signature checked, but
Gatekeeper, VoiceOver and installer flows are not claimed as physical-device validated. OS publisher-signing status
depends on final public-asset inspection.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.1/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.1/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [Compare v0.9.0...v0.9.1](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1)
